research.name: react-native-graph
research.note: Skia line graph for React Native that morphs between data ranges and dims the line ahead of your finger while you scrub.

effects: line path morphing between time ranges
scrub gesture that fades the line ahead of the finger and tracks it with a haloed selection dot
min and max value labels pinned to the curve's extremes
